set.body: From the reviews of c88892e4d and 5b3cfbe74. No killing test for: materialize's execution-summary freeze hash, the recording-vs-request mention check, validate's candidate-branch checks (outside allowed, duplicates, empty), absent-with-ids, wrong fields, deictic with a list, finish_reason/tool_calls in interpret, execute-side producer hash, budget range and per-request identity, materialize inputs/producer hashes, prepare's class refusal, and that HTTP error bodies and the key never reach artifacts. Add a Python-to-Scala round-trip test (T6). Add a round-level spend ledger: the USD 5 ceiling is checked per experiment only.
